mapper.insert: insert into lab_reservation( reservation_no, lab_id, applicant_user_id, approver_user_id, reservation_type, priority_level, usage_purpose, course_or_project_name, participant_count, contact_phone, status, reject_reason, check_in_time, check_out_time ) values( #{reservationNo}, #{labId}, #{applicantUserId}, #{approverUserId}, #{reservationType}, #{priorityLevel}, #{usagePurpose}, #{courseOrProjectName}, #{participantCount}, #{contactPhone}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime} )
mapper.select: select r.id as reservationId, r.reservation_no as reservationNo, r.lab_id as labId, l.lab_name as labName, r.applicant_user_id as applicantUserId, first_slot.reservation_date as reservationDate, first_slot.period_id as periodId, first_slot.period_name as periodName, first_slot.start_time as startTime, first_slot.end_time as endTime, r.check_in_time as checkInTime from lab_reservation r join lab l on l.id = r.lab_id join ( select s.reservation_id, s.reservation_date, s.period_id, p.period_name, p.start_time, p.end_time from lab_reservation_slot s join class_period p on p.id = s.period_id join ( select s1.reservation_id, min(timestamp(s1.reservation_date, p1.start_time)) as first_start_at from lab_reservation_slot s1 join class_period p1 on p1.id = s1.period_id where s1.slot_status = 1 and s1.reservation_date = #{reservationDate} group by s1.reservation_id ) first_time on first_time.reservation_id = s.reservation_id and timestamp(s.reservation_date, p.start_time) = first_time.first_start_at where s.slot_status = 1 and s.reservation_date = #{reservationDate} ) first_slot on first_slot.reservation_id = r.id where r.applicant_user_id = #{userId} and r.lab_id = #{labId} and r.status = 2 order by first_slot.start_time asc, r.id asc

select r.id as reservationId, r.reservation_no as reservationNo, r.lab_id as labId, l.lab_name as labName, r.applicant_user_id as applicantUserId, first_slot.reservation_date as reservationDate, first_slot.period_id as periodId, first_slot.period_name as periodName, first_slot.start_time as startTime, first_slot.end_time as endTime, r.check_in_time as checkInTime from lab_reservation r join lab l on l.id = r.lab_id join ( select s.reservation_id, s.reservation_date, s.period_id, p.period_name, p.start_time, p.end_time from lab_reservation_slot s join class_period p on p.id = s.period_id join ( select s1.reservation_id, min(timestamp(s1.reservation_date, p1.start_time)) as first_start_at from lab_reservation_slot s1 join class_period p1 on p1.id = s1.period_id where s1.slot_status = 1 group by s1.reservation_id ) first_time on first_time.reservation_id = s.reservation_id and timestamp(s.reservation_date, p.start_time) = first_time.first_start_at where s.slot_status = 1 ) first_slot on first_slot.reservation_id = r.id where r.status = 2 and r.check_in_time is null and not exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role sr on sr.id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = r.applicant_user_id and (sr.role_code = 'TEACHER' or sr.role_code = 'ROLE_TEACHER') ) and first_slot.reservation_date <= #{currentDate} order by first_slot.reservation_date asc, first_slot.start_time asc, r.id asc
